data.name: PolicyUsage
data.value:
Usage: localai policy show localai policy set --residency <RequireFullVram|AllowPartialOffload|AllowCpu> localai policy set --idle-model-keep-alive-seconds <non-negative integer> localai policy set --update-check <on|off> localai policy set --update-check-interval-hours <{0}..{1}> localai policy set --language <en|ru|system>
RequireFullVram Модель должна быть целиком в видеопамяти. По умолчанию. AllowPartialOffload Часть модели может уйти в системную память. Нужен адаптер, вмещающий хотя бы часть модели. Медленнее. AllowCpu Модели могут работать целиком на процессоре. Работает без пригодного адаптера; намного медленнее. Удержание модели Сколько секунд держать загруженной простаивающую модель. Ноль выгружает её сразу — это значение по умолчанию. Обновления Может ли эта установка спрашивать у GitHub, есть ли релиз новее. По умолчанию выключена; ничего никогда не скачивается и не устанавливается без вашего запроса. Язык вывода На каком языке отвечают CLI и MCP-инструменты. По умолчанию — как настроен этот компьютер, а где перевода нет — по-английски. Команды и имена опций никогда не переводятся.
data.comment: Usage: and every syntax line are byte-identical in both languages. The description column is 23; a Russian caption longer than 19 characters moves it for all six rows.

data.name: PositionNotFromOne
data.value: invalid_position: строки и колонки считаются с единицы; получено: строка {0}, колонка {1}.
data.comment: Word for word CodeSearchText.PositionNotFromOne, deliberately duplicated: this CLI is what the instruction block offers when that MCP server is unreachable, and the block quotes the sentence as a literal. LocalAi.Cli does not reference CodeSearch.Mcp, so the two cannot share one resource; a test compares them.

data.name: ProfileUnknown
data.value: Команде localai {0} неизвестен профиль задачи '{1}'. Поддерживаемые профили: {2}
data.comment: Command-agnostic because read-image and translate need the same refusal with a different set, and two parallel keys would drift. No full stop: the line ends in a list somebody copies, the reason HookEventUnknown gives.

data.name: ProgressMinutesLeft
data.value: Осталось примерно {0} мин.
data.comment: Leading space: a clause appended to the line above. Empty on the first fragment, where nothing has been measured yet, and never a bare number without about - it is a mean over completed fragments, and the fallback pass can double it. F1 and invariant, the format IndexBuilder already prints an ETA in.

data.name: ProgressPullDownloading
data.value: Скачивается {0}: {1} из {2} ГБ.
data.comment: Two figures and no percent on purpose: the total is summed over the layer digests as they appear, so it can grow, and a percent against a growing denominator moves backwards. Both figures only ever increase. Printed on the silence clock rather than per byte - a byte threshold would encode the connection's speed into the cadence. Three identical lines mean the download has stalled, and that is information.

data.name: ProgressPullPreparing
data.value: Подготовка к скачиванию {0}: {1} с.
data.comment: The manifest fetch, before any layer size is known. It exists so the run explains why no size is on offer yet.

data.name: ProgressPullStatus
data.value: Ollama сообщает: {0}. {1} с.
data.comment: Ollama's own status, quoted rather than mapped to one of our phases. Silence here would recreate this defect for every status Ollama adds later. The token is never translated, and it is collapsed to one line and cut to 60 characters before it reaches this sentence.

data.name: ProgressPullStoring
data.value: Модель добавляется в Ollama: {0} с.
data.comment: After the bytes and the hash: writing the manifest, and removing layers no model needs any more. Minutes on a large model, and silence here reads as a run that finished and then hung.

data.name: ProgressPullVerifying
data.value: Проверяется скачанное: {0} с.
data.comment: Hashing the whole file, after the download line has already reached its own total. Without a line of its own this phase reads as finished-then-hung.

data.name: ProgressQueued
data.value: Ожидание в очереди брокера: {0} с.
data.comment: Printed only into silence: first at 10 s of a run that has said nothing, then at every 30 s since the last line of any kind. The state is LocalJobState.Queued as the broker client's poll loop reads it, never a guess - a line saying the model is working while the job has not started is the false reassurance this pair exists to refuse.

data.name: ProgressRunning
data.value: Модель работает: {0} с.
data.comment: Its pair, for LocalJobState.Running. The number is time in the current state rather than since the command started, so the two lines together read as a timeline.

data.name: ProgressTranslatingFragment
data.value: Переводится фрагмент {0} из {1}.{2}
data.comment: Printed before the call, not after: the total is known before the first one, and it is the fact that decides whether the reader waits. {2} is ProgressMinutesLeft or empty.

data.name: ProgressTranslationRetry
data.value: Проверка структуры не пройдена ({0}), поэтому весь документ переводится заново с фрагмента 1, моделью {1}.
data.comment: The fallback pass re-translates the whole document, so the counter restarts at 1; without this line that reads as a defect. {0} is the validator's own detail, {1} the model tag, which is never translated.

data.name: ProgressTriageChoosingModel
data.value: Выбор модели для этого лога и её загрузка.
data.comment: Before the capacity probe, which loads a model to find out whether it fits: it unloads others, preflights at a context size and checks residency, stepping down on failure. Minutes of silence otherwise, before anything else about the run can be said.

data.name: ProgressTriageFragment
data.value: Разбор фрагмента {0}; с начала прошло {1} с.
data.comment: No of N on purpose: fragments are streamed off the log and the total is not known until it ends. The elapsed is since the command started, unlike the heartbeat's, and the wording says so.

data.name: ProgressTriageLogRead
data.value: Лог прочитан полностью: фрагментов {0}.
data.comment: The total, at the first moment it is true. Noun-first in Russian: ResourceManager has no plural support.

data.name: ProgressTriageMerging
data.value: Слияние частичных выводов: {0} (уровень {1}).
data.comment: Merges also happen mid-stream when a level overflows its budget, so this must not be read as the log having been read. level is the reduction level the prompt itself names.

data.comment: Two different events on one row: a job record deleted, and a response body deleted from a record that stays. The Russian keeps both nouns for that reason, noun-first.

data.name: PruneDryRun

data.comment: The rows below count what would go and are identical in both modes, so this line is what tells the two apart. It used to be one word in capitals at the end of the report.

data.name: PruneLauncherBackups

data.comment: The localai: stderr prefix stays inside the value. The word repository is new: the line used to print twelve bare hex characters between two colons. The Russian tail is WorktreeNotInspectable's, verbatim, so the two read as a pair.

data.name: PruneQuarantine

data.comment: No megabytes: quarantine bytes are counted inside the archive row, and a size here would double-count them.

data.value:
Usage: localai update [--wait] [--force]
Ставит поверх текущей самый новый подписанный релиз. Манифест проверяется встроенным ключом релиза до того, как будет скачан пакет; пакет — по манифесту до распаковки; указатель версии переключается атомарно, когда оба проверены.
--wait Ждать завершения заданий в очереди брокера, не больше {0} мин, вместо отказа. --force Ставить самый новый релиз, даже если он не новее текущего.
Требования, модели и интеграции с клиентами не затрагиваются — для них запустите установщик.
